messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that translates C++ code to Python 3 code. The code should reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
ratio = x / y
best_num, best_den = 1, 1
min_diff = 1e9
epsilon = 1e-25

if y <= best_den:
    print(f"{x}/{y}")
else:
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        val = ratio * i
        a1 = int(val // 1)
        a2 = a1 + 1
        diff1 = abs(ratio - a1 / i)
        if diff1 < min_diff - epsilon:
            min_diff = diff1
            best_num = a1
            best_den = i
        diff2 = abs(a2 / i - ratio)
        if diff2 < min_diff - epsilon:
            min_diff = diff2
            best_num = a2
            best_den = i
    print(f"{best_num}/{best_den}")
